newsitem.title: CONGO: South Africans call Zaire news conference.
newsitem.headline: South Africans call Zaire news conference.

text.p: South African organisers of Zaire's shipborne peace talks called a news conference on Sunday amid speculation that a deal was to be announced.
South African officials told journalists on board the converted icebreaker SAS Outeniqua to prepare television cameras for the news conference.
President Nelson Mandela would sit between Zaire's veteran President Mobutu Sese Seko and rebel leader Laurent Kabila, they said.

Officials said earlier that Mobutu had agreed to stand down as part of a transitional process. A rebel spokesman told Reuters from the ship that Kabila and his advisers were looking at a proposal from Mobutu. He gave no details.
Mandela's deputy, Thabo Mbeki, and Mohamed Sahnoun, the U.N. and Organisation of African Unity special envoy on Zaire, would also attend the news conference, the officials said.
